description: Queue an owner-approved email campaign for sending to real customers, within its daily limit. Business owner only. Emails cannot be unsent once delivered; cancel_email_campaign stops what has not gone out yet. A queued result is not proof any email was delivered. Campaign email only goes from the business’s own verified sending domain, to customers with recorded email permission who are not on the do-not-email list, within the daily amount the business’s Kai level allows.

business_id.description: The business that sends the email.
